FIELDS.NAME: Rapid Response Ambulance Services
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Rapid Response Ambulance Services specializes in providing emergency medical transport to licensed hospital emergency rooms. Our operations are supported by a dedicated dispatch team available 24/7 to ensure rapid response times for medical emergencies. Our highly trained staff consists solely of certified EMTs and paramedics who are committed to maintaining the highest standards of patient care. We prioritize the regular maintenance and inspection of our ambulance fleet to comply with all applicable regulatory guidelines, ensuring the safety of both patients and personnel during transport. Furthermore, we have instituted a formal quality assurance program and an incident reporting system to continually improve our service delivery and maintain compliance with local, state, and federal regulations. Accurate record-keeping for all dispatch and patient transports reinforces our commitment to accountability and quality care.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 05/15/2021, our ambulance was involved in a minor accident while responding to an emergency call, resulting in repair costs of $25,000. The claim was settled and the status is closed. On 08/20/2022, a medical negligence complaint was filed against our team, costing $75,000 in legal fees and ultimately dismissed in court, status closed. Additionally, on 11/10/2023, we incurred $50,000 for equipment damage due to a sudden equipment failure, with the claim currently pending approval.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class: II, Grade: B, Label: Secure Vault
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and 24/7 watchpersons on-site for enhanced protection of emergency vehicles and equipment.
